appropriate_uses: Saudi official position, coalition statements, warnings, port-access claims, and Gulf-state diplomatic or security posture.
inappropriate_uses: Independent verification of contested operational outcomes, vessel movement, battle damage, or actor intent beyond the stated Saudi position.
known_failure_modes: State messaging; selective disclosure; coalition-attribution incentives; multilingual editions may differ in detail or timing.
name: Saudi Press Agency
observables: Saudi official statements, royal and ministry positions, coalition communiques, warnings, and port or infrastructure security language
originating_chain_rule: Saudi Press Agency Arabic, English, Persian, other language editions, ministry reposts, and state-media reproductions of one Saudi or coalition statement remain one originating chain.

review_history.note: Added after VER-20260806-02 exposed SPA as a recurring Saudi official-position source for Bab al-Mandab and Saudi infrastructure/security posture.
